categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in electrical equipment inspection and testing services, including AC/DC high voltage and ultra-high voltage switchgear, ±500kV and above DC transmission equipment, and 800kV and above AC long-distance transmission equipment. Other business segments include metrology services, certification services, technical research, and technical consulting. The core business is inspection and testing services, supported by extensive experience and advanced technology in electrical equipment testing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed nine major core technologies including electrical equipment product standard research and verification, high voltage and large current metrology, high voltage switch testing, winding equipment testing, DC transmission valve testing, insulator and arrester testing, power capacitor testing, key performance core technologies for electrical equipment, and intelligent manufacturing technologies for electrical equipment. It holds numerous patents and software copyrights and has established advanced testing platforms and systems for high voltage and ultra-high voltage equipment, including international firsts in certain test types.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include electrical equipment manufacturers, power grid companies such as State Grid Corporation of China and China Southern Power Grid, and international clients. The company serves the power transmission, transformation, and distribution sectors, providing testing and certification for high voltage electrical equipment critical to grid stability and safety. It also serves emerging markets in renewable energy equipment testing and certification.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with headquarters in Xi'an and subsidiaries in Changzhou, Shenyang, and Qingdao. It has expanded overseas business with orders from countries including Turkey, Russia, Indonesia, and Brazil. The company maintains a strong domestic presence and is actively promoting international cooperation and market expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a midstream service provider in the electrical equipment supply chain, focusing on third-party testing, certification, metrology, and technical consulting services. It is independent from equipment manufacturing and end-user operations, providing objective and authoritative quality assurance and technical support to upstream manufacturers and downstream grid operators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening core testing technologies, expanding new energy and smart grid testing capabilities, and enhancing certification and metrology services. The company emphasizes innovation in green and intelligent electrical equipment, with significant R&D investment (over 10% of revenue) and numerous ongoing projects targeting advanced switchgear, DC transmission, and environmental performance evaluation. It also focuses on digital transformation and smart laboratory construction to improve efficiency and service quality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of inspection and testing services, including type tests, performance tests, and research tests, as well as metrology, certification, and technical consulting services. The company signs service agreements with clients and issues authoritative reports upon completion. It also earns investment income from cash management activities and government subsidies related to R&D and infrastructure projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading third-party testing institution in China's electrical equipment sector, especially in high voltage and ultra-high voltage domains. It holds numerous national-level testing qualifications and research platforms, giving it a competitive edge. While the industry is fragmented with many small players, the company’s scale, technical capabilities, and brand recognition position it as a dominant player with strong market share and influence in both domestic and international markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 602 million, a 15.53% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 162 million, up 24.56%. Total assets grew by 52.39% to RMB 3.44 billion, and shareholders' equity increased by 62.84% to RMB 3.01 billion. The company successfully completed its IPO on the Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market in June 2023, raising over RMB 1 billion in net proceeds, fueling growth and R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers authoritative, independent, and comprehensive testing and certification services with high technical barriers and strong credibility, essential for ensuring the safety and reliability of critical electrical equipment. Its extensive national-level qualifications, advanced testing platforms, and participation in international standard-setting bodies differentiate it from competitors. The company’s deep industry expertise, innovation capabilities, and integrated service offerings provide significant value to customers by supporting product quality, regulatory compliance, and technological advancement in the power sector.
